model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) across multiple conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and spans a linear scale from 1 to 1000, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale from 0 to 65, with tick labels from 0 to 65, incrementing by 5. The "Base" condition is represented by a black solid line with circular markers and starts at approximately 43% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1, rising to approximately 53% ACC at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The "FT" condition is shown as a blue solid line with circular markers, beginning near 48% ACC at 1 and leveling off to approximately 51% ACC at 1000. The "IKE" condition is depicted as a red solid line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 46% ACC at 1 and increasing to roughly 51% ACC at 1000. The "MEMIT" condition appears as a magenta solid line with diamond markers, beginning near 50% ACC at 1, and increasing to around 56% ACC at 1000. The "MEND" condition is shown as a light red solid line with diamond markers, beginning around 51% ACC at 1 and reaching approximately 56% ACC at 1000. Finally, the "ROME" condition is represented by a green solid line with square markers, starting at approximately 50% ACC at 1 and reaching approximately 61% ACC at 1000.
